evidence: Added estimatePayloadTokens to TokenEstimator with syntax-aware regex (len/2.2 punctuation/keys, len/2.8 identifiers, len/4.0 natural language, 1.12x JSON safety buffer). Updated limiter.ts estimateTokens to delegate string/object payloads. Updated agent.ts LimiterRunRequest tokens. AC-01 verified with error margin <8% in tokenEstimator.test.ts. tsc --noEmit passed. 110/110 test files (959/959 tests) passed.

Introduced configurable maxBudgetWaitMs (65s strict, 10s interactive). Queueing via await sleep(wait) prevents premature failovers. Split classifyProviderError into rate_limit vs server_error, preventing 429 bursts from opening circuit breaker. Implemented Retry-After / x-ratelimit-reset parsing with 200-800ms jitter retry in baseOpenAi.ts and gemini.ts. AC-02 (15k Groq tokens queueing without failover) and AC-03 (429 Retry-After handling without circuit trip) verified in limiterBackpressure.test.ts (5/5 pass). Full suite: 111/111 files, 964/964 tests pass.

Implemented getProviderChunkLimits, fitChunkToProvider, and partitionChunkForProvider in analystExecution.ts and clusterPipeline.ts with targetChunkTokens = Math.min(providerMaxInputTokens * 0.75, 6000). Upgraded TokenEstimator.truncateToTokens to syntax-aware token estimation. AC-04 verified in dynamicChunkSizing.test.ts (Groq chunks <= 1,500 tokens; Gemini chunks utilize up to 6,000 tokens). Full vitest suite: 112/112 files, 967/967 tests passed.

Implemented pre-flight wave token budget aggregation and sequential pacing in clusterPipeline.ts with micro-delays when globalProviderLimiter.budgetWaitMs > 0. Verified in waveBudgetPacing.test.ts (2/2 pass). Full suite: 113/113 files, 969/969 tests passed.

Implemented context-capacity filtering in SpecialistAffinityRouter.planDistribution using TokenEstimator; filters low-capacity models (maxInputTokens <= 1500) on chunks > 1,500 tokens. Re-exported SpecialistAffinityRouter from router.ts. Verified in capacityRoutingAffinity.test.ts (5/5 pass). Full vitest suite: 114/114 files, 974/974 tests passed.

Constructed 2-tier tree reduction in clusterPipeline.ts partitioning reports into sub-manager intermediate ClusterDigests. Updated compileSynthesisPrompt in synthesisPipeline.ts so root manager synthesizes only the resulting ClusterDigests with strict token capping (< 4000 tokens) using TokenEstimator. Verified in hierarchicalMapReduce.test.ts (2/2 pass). Full test verification passed: npm run lint (0 errors), npm run test:unit (115/115 files, 976/976 tests), npm run test:portable, npm run test:simulation, npm run test:dist, npm run test:cli, npm run test:server.
